Varun Jharkhandi

how does the agent handle journeys that include things like popups, dropdowns or content that only appears after a user interaction?

Report

Sean Dowdall

DevAlly

Maker

@jharkhandi\_chora1 Great question! Yes, the agent captures every step of a user journey, including modals, dropdowns, error states and anything that only appears after an interaction. It works through your product in a real browser, so if a person can get to it, the agent can too.

Hover-only menus, drag and drop, and iframes aren't supported yet. If a journey needs one of those, the agent tells you upfront rather than recording something that quietly breaks.

If you’d like to give it a go you can sign up for our free tier and have the agent record a journey through your own product!
